trails.note: Open cut directly under the diagonal lift (red line from its top terminal ~(2003,594) down-left); the Lift Line diamond (1488,959) sits on the lift. Traced along the lift from the top terminal down to the Micky/Taxi junction, stopping just above the Lower Lift Line square (~1339,1061) where the name changes. The top ~120 px of the corridor is shared with Deliverance (above the lift) and Upper Can Am (below it).

Starts at Northway (~1442,598) opposite the bottom of Green Beret, passes its blue square (1455,665), follows the cut down-left and round the bend (open snow, low tree density all the way) to the Taxi/Angel's Wiggle junction (~1305,900), then continues down the narrow strip between two tree bands to the Lower Milk Run square (1126,1024). That last stretch below the Taxi square is inferred as the Milk Run continuing until the 'Lower' label; if it belongs to Lower Milk Run, cut the trace at ~(1305,900).

Clean straight open strip parallel to the lift (the old 2017-18 map calls it Power Line); the 601 diamond (1532,822) sits in it. Top: the strip meets Northway at ~(1836,562) and its upper ~100 px is shared with Canyonland, which branches off to the left at ~(1760,622). Bottom: opens into the Micky/Taxi junction above the Micky label (~1352,979).

Painted as a lighter strip with scattered trees (not a clean cut) between two dense tree bands; the diamond (1513,736) sits at its lower edge. Traced from Northway (~1836,562) down the strip shared with 601 to where the two strips separate (~1760,622), then left along the sparse strip (about 80 px upslope of, and parallel to, 601), ending where it opens into the Upper Milk Run cut below the upper Angel's Wiggle label (~1325,855). The shared top with 601 is inferred: that merge is the only opening from Canyonland's strip to Northway.

Clear winding cut from just below the ski-area boundary on the ridge (~1580,292), through its diamond (1535,438), swinging left then back right down to Northway at ~(1490,586), opposite the top of Upper Milk Run.

From the top of the lift corridor (~1975,629) it passes right of a small tree clump and runs down the lower (SE) side of the wide open corridor beside the lift, which it shares with the Lift Line cut, to ~(1640,900). There a tree band splits off the lift cut and Upper Can Am follows its own open cut through its diamond (1629,954) down to the slow zone where Lower Can Am starts (~1410,1110). Its upper half has no cut of its own (shared corridor), so that part is the less certain half.

NO CUT (checked on a crop: the diamond sits in a lightly treed strip beside the Lift Line cut; a parallel guess would overlap Lift Line; marker at the label). Tracer: No clean open cut: the diamond (1737,749) sits in a lightly treed strip on the upper-left (NW) side of the Lift Line cut, between the lift and the denser tree row below 601. Traced about 30 px above the lift, parallel to it, along that strip from the lift top (first ~120 px squeezed against the lift, where it shares the corridor with Lift Line) down to the Micky/Taxi junction (~1383,1006). Tree density only rises gradually away from the lift, so this may instead be the upper edge of the Lift Line cut itself.

Open band from the tram-line corridor (~2002,432, just right of the blue dashed inset border) running down-left across the slope just above its label text, to its blue square (1725,493); from there it bends down round the tree island to Northway (~1735,560). The top end at the tram line is the least certain part; the open slope right of the tree island (x~1880-1960) was not included.
